content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Develop the strategic plan through fact-finding, future vision, scenario development and plan preparation, integrating existing service-line, behavioral-health and telehealth plans."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Assess current and future market and organizational position, including demographics, payer mix, inpatient/outpatient/surgical market share, industry trends and system leakage."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Conduct a system-of-care survey and 20-30 interviews to assess service-line offerings and performance and complement quantitative analysis."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Analyze policy, reimbursement, technology and care-delivery trends and identify growth opportunities aligned with UNMH clinical, research and fiscal priorities."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Define implementation goals, tactics and required resources, including consideration of value-based revenue, strategic financial models and facility-investment priorities."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Project inpatient and outpatient volumes over three-, five- and ten-year horizons using market analysis and leadership input, with adjustments for COVID-19 effects."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Document facility deficiencies affecting operations or patient satisfaction and analyze alternative strategies for future inpatient and outpatient service and facility needs."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Analyze outpatient referral and utilization patterns and model how alternative growth strategies affect inpatient services."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Assess opportunities to consolidate or expand selected services with other healthcare providers."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Recommend how emerging technologies affect building design and IT infrastructure and assess IT opportunities for greater health-system integration."},{"requirement_id":"R11","evidence":"Work with the strategic planning committee and key stakeholders on findings and recommendations and support requested trustee or stakeholder presentations."}]}
